_about: Sound catalog for aashish-cooks. gain is dB added to the file. role says when it plays. Meme sounds are cleared for use (the owner has permission), client reels included; at most sfx.meme_max per reel (default 4). peak = seconds into the file where a riser hits its top (it is placed so the peak lands on the cue).

meme-sting.note: 2.8 s meme clip from the owner's pack (unnamed): use on a funny beat

moments._about: Sound moments learned from Aashish's edits. The planner finds these in the transcript and adds {"fx":"sfx"} effects; they are not automatic.

shock hook line.at: the last words of the line
shock hook line.example: 0:02 'Pichhle 24 ghanton ne poori duniya ko hila ke rakh diya hai' -> surprise on 'diya hai'
shock hook line.why: the world just got turned upside down

shocking fact.example: 0:08 'jisne PHP mein critical bugs ... kiye' -> faaah on 'kiye'

money talk.at: the end of the money phrase
money talk.example: 0:12 'tumhare liye ek earning opportunity bhi ho sakti hai' -> cash on 'sakti hai'
money talk.why: the line is about money (earning, reward, dollar, paisa, kamao, price, free)

a task being done.example: 0:13-0:18 'companies ... vulnerability discover ... ethical hackers ... bug bounty' -> cooking bed for 5 s
a task being done.why: someone is working: finding, scanning, researching, building, analysing

hard hit / slam.why: a stamp, a slam, a knockout fact, 'khatam'

unbelievable number.why: a stat so big it's funny ('10 lakh', '1000x')

win / excited.at: the end of the win line
win / excited.why: got paid, it worked, it's free

silly mistake.why: a dumb error, a typo, 'galti se'

awkward / cringe.at: after the awkward line, in the silence

funny reveal.why: a funny twist; yooo for hype, funny-reveal (arkh) for a silly twist

other funny beat.at: the end of the funny line
other funny beat.why: a joke that needs a button
